_comment: threatRating is 1 to 10. drops reference item ids from items.json where possible. images is empty until staff upload art; the browser falls back to the icon-enemy placeholder.

enemies.name: Ashback Hound
enemies.description: A lean, soot-streaked hound that hunts in pairs along burned-out roads.
enemies.lore: Survivors of early scenario collapses describe packs of these hounds moving through ash fall like it was ordinary weather.
enemies.behaviour: Circles prey before committing, favors flanking a target that has already engaged something else.
skills: Pack Flank: advantage on Athletics when a second hound is adjacent to the same target
encounterIdeas: A pair guarding a supply cart
A pack of four cornering a lone survivor

enemies.name: Cinder Alpha
enemies.description: The pack leader of Ashback Hounds, larger, scarred, and considerably more patient.
enemies.lore: Packs led by a Cinder Alpha are reported to hold territory rather than simply hunt through it.
enemies.behaviour: Holds back from melee until at least one hound has drawn a reaction from the target.
skills: Rally the Pack: removes Frightened from all nearby hounds once per encounter
encounterIdeas: Boss encounter closing out a burned-road arc

enemies.name: Glass Wraith
enemies.description: A translucent, faintly humming shape that only fully appears in reflective surfaces.
enemies.lore: Nobody agrees on what a Glass Wraith actually is, only that it seems to remember rooms better than the people who built them.
enemies.behaviour: Avoids direct confrontation, prefers to isolate a target and unsettle them before striking.
skills: Mirror Step: can move between any two reflective surfaces within sight
enemies.habitat: Abandoned interiors with intact mirrors or glass
encounterIdeas: A haunted-house style scenario in a collapsed mall
Hunting a party member isolated from the group

enemies.name: Iron Choir Sentinel
enemies.description: A tall constructed figure that hums a layered, wordless tone as it moves.
enemies.lore: Standing guard over sites tied to older scenarios, Sentinels do not appear to act on their own initiative so much as follow instructions long since given.
enemies.behaviour: Holds position until a trigger condition is met, then commits fully with no self-preservation instinct.
skills: Choir Resonance: deals minor ongoing damage to all characters within close range each round
enemies.habitat: Guarding fixed sites tied to older scenarios
encounterIdeas: A gatekeeper boss blocking access to a codex-relevant location

enemies.name: The Uncounted
enemies.description: A shifting mass of shapes that never quite resolves into a single countable enemy.
enemies.lore: Reports on The Uncounted never agree on numbers. Some parties log one target, others log a dozen, from the same encounter.
enemies.behaviour: Splits and merges through a fight, making it difficult to focus damage on any one part.
skills: Fracture: splits into two lower-HP copies when reduced below half health, once per encounter
enemies.habitat: Sites where a scenario collapsed without a clean resolution
encounterIdeas: Arc-ending boss encounter for a mid to high level party
